title: Class 12 Chemistry Equation Bank - CBSE / NCERT (Rationalized Syllabus)
notation: Chemical equations use LaTeX with the mhchem package (\ce{...}); physical-chemistry formulas use standard LaTeX.
coverage_note: Only equations physically present in the uploaded source text were extracted; none were reconstructed from memory. Coverage is very uneven between the two parts of the book because of how the original PDF was converted to Markdown: Part I (Units 1-5: Solutions, Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics, d-/f-Block Elements, Coordination Compounds) is physical-chemistry-heavy and its equations were mostly typed as inline text, so they survived conversion well and this bank captures them thoroughly (~140 equations). Part II (Units 6-10: Haloalkanes and Haloarenes, Alcohols/Phenols/Ethers, Aldehydes/Ketones/Carboxylic Acids, Amines, Biomolecules) consists almost entirely of organic reaction schemes and structural diagrams that were rendered as images in the original PDF; these images did not survive conversion to Markdown at all, leaving only surrounding prose. As a result, Units 6, 8, and 9 have effectively zero recoverable equations, and Units 7 and 10 have only one each. If you can provide these five files in a format that preserves the reaction schemes (e.g. higher-fidelity OCR, or images of the reaction schemes themselves), I can extract the organic chemistry content properly.
